note: Provider capability manifest. CATANA separates creative direction (spec + prompts) from execution (a provider). 'kind': connector = an MCP connector Claude calls; local = runs on this machine; export = writes files only. 'available_when' tells Claude how to detect it. Capabilities of connectors are a SNAPSHOT (date in 'snapshot'): always re-verify at run time with the provider's discovery tool before executing. 'cost': free | credits | user_reports_free. Paid providers never run without the user's explicit approval of the quoted cost.

operations.style_transfer: restyle an image keeping its subject
operations.outpaint: extend an image beyond its borders
operations.first_last: video between a first and a last frame
operations.multi_ref_video: video from several reference images (identity/product consistency)
operations.motion_transfer: transfer motion from a reference video
operations.lipsync: lip-sync a face video to audio
operations.motion_graphics: code-rendered motion graphics film (kinetic type, UI, data)
operations.voice_convert: re-voice a recording into another voice

cost_policies.free_first: Rank free providers first. A paid provider is only offered as an option; it runs only after the user approves the quoted cost.
cost_policies.free_only: Never select a paid provider. If no free provider supports the operation, fall back to prompt_only.
cost_policies.best_quality: Rank by capability fit regardless of cost (still needs quote + approval before any spend).

policy.success_requires: an asset URL, asset id or job id returned by the provider; a call that returned none is not a success
policy.audio_cost_policy_note: User requirement: sound and voice must be free. Audio operations default to free_only (VoiceStudio, the CATANA SFX mixer, or a prompt/script pack); paid audio runs only if the user explicitly asks for that provider.

voice_studio.label: VoiceStudio (local, free)
voice_studio.available_when: the VoiceStudio app is running on the user's machine: GET {base_url}/health answers. base_url = $CATANA_VOICE_STUDIO_URL or http://127.0.0.1:3900. Must run where that address is reachable (Claude Code on the same computer) — a cloud session cannot reach the user's localhost.
voice_studio.auth: none on loopback; remote access needs 'Authorization: Bearer $OMNIVOICE_API_KEY'

endpoints.speech: POST /v1/audio/speech {model, input<=4096, voice, instructions, instruct, response_format, speed 0.25-4, language, duration, seed}

voice_studio.notes: User's preferred and free provider for everything voice. No sound-effect or music generation: SFX come from catana_motion (procedural, free) and music from the user's own track. Client: engine/catana_core/voice_studio.py; CLI: scripts/catana.py voice ...

catana_motion.label: CATANA motion engine (local)
catana_motion.available_when: Node 18+, Python 3 (numpy scipy soundfile pyloudnorm pillow) and Chrome/Chromium on the machine
catana_motion.notes: Deterministic code-rendered films (kinetic type, rebuilt UI, data, 3D models) with procedural SFX on the user's own music track. 'sfx' here = procedural sound effects mixed to picture cues, not generative audio. No voice synthesis, no AI footage.

prompt_only.label: Prompt pack export
prompt_only.notes: Writes production-ready prompts, settings and a voiceover script to disk. Nothing is generated; the result status is 'prompt_only', never 'succeeded'.

higgsfield.label: Higgsfield
higgsfield.discovery: models_explore(action:'recommend' | 'get'); balance() for credits; generate_*(get_cost:true) preflights cost without submitting

seedance_2_5.refs: start/end image, image, video, audio references

cinematic_studio_video_4_0.notes: camera body, lens, aperture, lighting rig, palette controls

marketing_studio_video.notes: UGC / product ad formats with avatars and products

higgsfield.notes: In the reference session the account was on the free plan with 0 credits: generation needs credits or the user's explicit free-generation request.

runway.label: Runway
runway.snapshot: 2026-11-03 from tool schemas (whoami not yet run)
runway.discovery: whoami() lists the models the connected workspace can run; video, speech and sound effects need a paid workspace

elevenlabs.label: ElevenLabs (creative)
elevenlabs.discovery: creative_get_flow_node_types() lists runnable models; generate calls accept estimate_only:true to price without generating
elevenlabs.notes: Spends credits. The user declined a paid ElevenLabs call in the reference session — use only with explicit approval.
